featured.name: Pulso
featured.lead: Near real-time dashboard of Chile's economic indicators.
featured.shotAlt: Pulso screenshot: historical chart for one indicator and a grid of economic indicators

facts.v: Banco Central de Chile's SI3 API is hard to consume directly from the frontend and has non-trivial quirks.
End-to-end design and development, frontend and backend.

A custom intermediate API built with Next.js Route Handlers that wraps the source, with in-memory cache and a fallback for upstream failures. Ten indicators (UF, USD, CPI, IMACEC, MPR and others) with a grid, historical chart, favorites and a converter.
In production on Vercel, with unit tests in Vitest, end-to-end tests in Playwright and continuous integration on GitHub Actions.

items.name: DOM Digital
items.lead: SaaS to digitize municipal construction permits.

facts.v: The Dirección de Obras Municipales permits ran on a legacy system.
Built from scratch, gathering requirements directly with the client.
Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Firebase Auth, Azure.
Replaced the legacy system; deployed on Azure.

items.name: E-Hive
items.lead: EV charging management with license-plate verification.

facts.v: The platform needs to verify the license plate before enabling charging.
Solo development of the QR-scanning module and its endpoints.

items.name: Sucursal Virtual de iSalud
items.lead: Vouchers, reimbursements and certificates platform for a Codelco health insurer (Isapre).

facts.v: iSalud's Sucursal Virtual ran on a legacy frontend.
Individual modernization, supervised by a senior developer.
Migrated critical frontend features and added new methods in ASP.NET MVC microservices over Oracle (PL/SQL): doctor listings, patient lookup and other clinical flows.
Platform used by over 18,000 Codelco beneficiaries.

about.heading: About
about.intro: Background, path, and the way I like to work.

prose.rest: , graduated from Universidad Andrés Bello in 2025.

In just over two years I've shipped production software for the public and private sectors: a municipal management SaaS, the modernization of a Codelco health insurer's online branch, and my own tools for the Chilean market.
I work across the full stack, with a focus on React, Next.js and TypeScript.
